Mass in Honour of St Joseph

info.adoration: Adoration Room: Mon–Fri 08:00–21:00; Sat 09:30–19:00; Sun 08:00–19:00; Public Holidays 08:00–16:00.
info.confession: Confessions: 15 mins before all weekend Masses in the Reconciliation Rooms in Church.
devotions: Holy Hour: First Friday 20:00 in Main Church unless otherwise stated.
Mass in Honour of St Joseph: First Wednesday 20:00 in Main Church.
Divine Mercy: Every Friday 20:00 except First Friday in the Chapel of St Joseph.
Garden Rosary: First Saturday after the 17:30 Mass.
Grotto Rosary: Every 13th of the month after the 18:30 Mass on weekdays.
Holy Hour for Vocations: Every Third Thursday 20:00 in the Chapel of St Joseph.
good_to_know: 2nd Saturday 17:30 Mass is the Children's Mass during school term.
No 18:30 Mass in the Chapel of St Joseph on First Wednesday and First Friday.
